metadata.title: Sharp scalar and Ricci curvature pinching theorems for Lagrangian submanifolds in the homogeneous nearly Kähler Six-sphere
metadata.abstract: For connected closed Lagrangian submanifolds of the homogeneous nearly Kähler sphere $\mathbb S^6(1)$, we first establish a new integral inequality. Then, as applications we prove sharp pinching theorems for the scalar curvature $\tau$ and Ricci curvature Ric, respectively: $\tau \ge \tfrac{23}{8}$ implies either $\tau=6$ with it totally geodesic, or $\tau=\tfrac{23}{8}$ with it congruent to the embedded Berger sphere of Dillen--Verstraelen--Vrancken; whereas ${\rm Ric}\geq\frac18$ implies that the submanifold is either totally geodesic, or has constant sectional curvature $K=\tfrac{1}{16}$, or is congruent to the embedded Berger sphere of Dillen-Verstraelen-Vrancken.

analysis.workSummary: 对标准近 Kähler 六球中的闭连通 Lagrange 子流形，建立积分不等式并推导标量和 Ricci 曲率夹逼分类。
analysis.breakthrough: 标量曲率阈值 23/8 与 Ricci 阈值 1/8 对应明确几何模型。
analysis.limitations: 数字依赖单位六球与曲率规范；两条夹逼定理允许的模型不同。 本条依据官方摘要整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立全文核查为准。
